UAE Dominates India in One-Sided Hong Kong Sixes Encounter

04 Nov 2026, 10:29 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: news.abplive.com

1 min read

Key takeaways

Match Summary

India's participation in the Hong Kong International Sixes tournament faced a significant setback following a dominant performance by the United Arab Emirates (UAE). In a match defined by aggressive batting, the UAE secured a comprehensive victory, successfully chasing a target of 95 runs in only 4.2 overs without losing a single wicket.

Key Match Details

  • Format: Hong Kong Sixes (6-overs per side)
  • India Innings: Finished at 94 runs, setting a target of 95 for victory.
  • UAE Innings: Successfully chased the target in 26 deliveries (4.2 overs), finishing at 97/0.
  • Outcome: UAE won by 10 wickets (by chase completion).

Performance Analysis

The Indian batting unit struggled to build momentum in the shortened format, leaving their bowlers with a modest total to defend. The UAE openers capitalized on the opportunity, maintaining an aggressive run rate throughout their chase. This result follows an earlier defeat against Pakistan, where India failed to defend a target of 89.

Implications for the Tournament

Following consecutive losses, India faces mounting pressure in the competition. To remain in contention, the squad will require marked improvements in both batting depth and bowling accuracy. Fans looking for official results or tournament progression can verify details through the official Hong Kong Sixes social media channels or tournament organizers' websites.
